annotations.title: One API recovery scan: what it saw, its findings, the fixes and what changed since the last scan

description: Wraps GET /api/sites/{slug}/scans/{id}. One API recovery scan: what it saw, its findings, the fixes and what changed since the last scan. Call this for a scan's results: findings by weight with the places on the site, three to five fixes in words and as a block for a coding agent, and new, fixed and still-open findings since the previous scan. It never includes text from the scanned site.
name: sites_by_slug_scans_by_id

agentBlock.description: the fixes for a coding agent, written by our code: no text from the site

notChecked.description: findings this scan couldn't check again

compare.description: against the previous scan, for a re-scan; null otherwise

ending.description: how it ended: complete, team_stopped, we_stopped, ownership_lost, plan_changed, site_removed, blocked, budget, error

findings.description: findings by weight; null before the report

finishedAt.description: when it finished (ISO 8601, UTC); null when there's none

text.description: how to make it, in our words

places.description: up to 50 paths on the site

kind.description: a scan, a free re-scan of a finished one, or a re-run

startedAt.description: when it started (ISO 8601, UTC); null when there's none

state.description: where it is: being quoted, quoted, waiting, running, paused, finished, stopped early or failed

next_steps.description: calls that usually come next, each naming its tool

tool.description: the tool that makes this call

title: One API recovery scan: what it saw, its findings, the fixes and what changed since the last scan
